name: PRD Genie - Story Breakdown Child v1.0

parameters.jsCode: const stage=$input.first().json;const errors=[];if(stage.schema_version!=='1.0.0')errors.push('schema_version');if(stage.stage!=='prd_generation'||stage.execution_status!=='passed'||stage.decision!=='continue'||stage.next_route!=='story_breakdown')errors.push('PRD stage route invalid');if(stage.groundedness_percent!==100)errors.push('groundedness must be 100');if(!stage.observability?.parent_trace_id||!stage.observability?.stage_trace_id)errors.push('trace context missing');if(!stage.observability?.ingestion_accepted)errors.push('PRD Langfuse ingestion not accepted');if(stage.output?.test_id!=='T11'||stage.output?.contract_status!=='passed')errors.push('T11 contract not passed');const prd=stage.output?.prd;if(!prd||stage.output?.validation?.canonical_t11_coverage!==true)errors.push('validated canonical PRD missing');if(errors.length)throw new Error('Story child input mapping failed: '+errors.join('; '));const fr=prd.functional_requirements||[],nfr=prd.non_functional_requirements||[],ac=prd.acceptance_criteria||[];return [{json:{schema_version:'1.0.0',run_id:stage.run_id,test_id:'T12',input_type:'approved_prd',source_prd:{test_id:'T11',contract_status:'passed',groundedness_percent:100,document:prd.document,functional_requirements:fr,non_functional_requirements:nfr,acceptance_criteria:ac,user_personas:prd.user_personas||[],dependencies:prd.dependencies||[],open_questions:prd.open_questions||[]},authorization:{story_breakdown_allowed:true,basis:'T11 contract passed at 100% groundedness',approved_requirement_ids:[...fr.map(x=>x.id),...nfr.map(x=>x.id)],approved_acceptance_criteria_ids:ac.map(x=>x.id)},orchestration_context:{parent_trace_id:stage.observability.parent_trace_id,prd_generation_trace_id:stage.observability.stage_trace_id}}}];

const p=$input.first().json;const e=[];const eq=(a,b)=>JSON.stringify(a)===JSON.stringify(b);if(p.schema_version!=='1.0.0')e.push('schema_version');if(p.test_id!=='T12'||p.input_type!=='approved_prd')e.push('test identity');if(!/^RUN-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$/.test(p.run_id||''))e.push('run_id');if(p.source_prd?.test_id!=='T11'||p.source_prd?.contract_status!=='passed'||p.source_prd?.groundedness_percent!==100)e.push('approved PRD release');if(p.authorization?.story_breakdown_allowed!==true)e.push('authorization');if(!eq(p.authorization?.approved_requirement_ids,['FR-001','NFR-001']))e.push('requirement allowlist');if(!eq(p.authorization?.approved_acceptance_criteria_ids,['AC-001','AC-002']))e.push('acceptance allowlist');if(!eq((p.source_prd?.functional_requirements||[]).map(x=>x.id),['FR-001']))e.push('FR coverage');if(!eq((p.source_prd?.non_functional_requirements||[]).map(x=>x.id),['NFR-001']))e.push('NFR coverage');if(!eq((p.source_prd?.acceptance_criteria||[]).map(x=>x.id),['AC-001','AC-002']))e.push('AC coverage');if((p.source_prd?.user_personas||[]).length)e.push('unexpected personas');if((p.source_prd?.dependencies||[]).length)e.push('unexpected dependencies');if(e.length)throw new Error('Story entry validation failed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:{...p,entry_validation:{valid:true,validated_at:new Date().toISOString()}}}];

parameters.text:
=Generate the Story Breakdown for this approved PRD package. Return JSON only.

<approved_prd_package>
{{ JSON.stringify($json.package) }}
</approved_prd_package>

messageValues.message: You are the Story Breakdown Agent for PRD Genie. Prompt v1.0 connected exact shape. Return JSON only. Top-level fields exactly: schema_version, run_id, test_id, source_prd_run_id, epics, unresolved_questions. Use schema_version 1.1.0, test_id T12, and preserve the approved package run_id for both run IDs. EPIC-001 fields exactly id,title,description,status,source_requirement_ids,features; title Report Filtering; description 'Users should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status. Results must load in under 2 seconds.'; status grounded; sources FR-001,NFR-001. FEAT-001 fields exactly id,title,description,status,source_requirement_ids,stories; title Filter Reports; description 'Users should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status.'; status grounded; sources FR-001,NFR-001. CRITICAL: the child array is named stories, never user_stories. US-001 fields exactly id,persona,capability,benefit,story,priority,status,acceptance_criteria,dependencies,source_requirement_ids,source_acceptance_criteria_ids. Use persona user; capability 'filter reports by date range, category, and status'; benefit 'TBD - stakeholder input required'; story 'As a user, I want to filter reports by date range, category, and status so that TBD - stakeholder input is required.'; priority Unspecified; status partially_grounded; dependencies []; requirement sources FR-001,NFR-001; acceptance sources AC-001,AC-002. Acceptance criterion fields exactly id,criterion,source_requirement_ids. Use exact approved AC-001 and AC-002. Unresolved question fields exactly id,question,missing_field,source_requirement_ids. OQ-001 asks 'Which specific user persona needs report filtering?', missing_field 'persona specificity', source FR-001. OQ-002 asks 'What user benefit should report filtering deliver?', missing_field 'user-story benefit', source FR-001. Do not add or omit fields. Do not invent content. Return JSON only.

parameters.jsCode: const raw=$json.text??$json.output??$json.response;if(typeof raw!=='string')throw new Error('Story Breakdown Agent did not return text');let s=raw.trim();const f=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3);if(s.startsWith(f))s=s.replace(f+'json','').replace(f,'').trim();let p;try{p=JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){throw new Error('Story output is not JSON: '+e.message)}const c=$('Create Story Trace Context').first().json,expected={"schema_version":"1.1.0","run_id":c.package.run_id,"test_id":"T12","source_prd_run_id":c.package.run_id,"epics":[{"id":"EPIC-001","title":"Report Filtering","description":"Users should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status. Results must load in under 2 seconds.","status":"grounded","source_requirement_ids":["FR-001","NFR-001"],"features":[{"id":"FEAT-001","title":"Filter Reports","description":"Users should be able to required.","priority":"Unspecified","status":"partially_grounded","acceptance_criteria":[{"id":"AC-001","criterion":"Reports can be filtered by date range, category, and status.","source_requirement_ids":["FR-001"]},{"id":"AC-002","criterion":"Results load in under 2 seconds.","source_requirement_ids":["NFR-001"]}],"dependencies":[],"source_requirement_ids":["FR-001","NFR-001"],"source_acceptance_criteria_ids":["AC-001","AC-002"]}]}]}],"unresolved_questions":[{"id":"OQ-001","question":"Which specific user persona needs report filtering?","missing_field":"persona specificity","source_requirement_ids":["FR-001"]},{"id":"OQ-002","question":"What user benefit should report filtering deliver?","missing_field":"user-story benefit","source_requirement_ids":["FR-001"]}]},eq=(a,b)=>JSON.stringify(a)===JSON.stringify(b),errors=[];if(p.schema_version!=='1.1.0'||p.test_id!=='T12')errors.push('identity');if(p.run_id!==c.package.run_id||p.source_prd_run_id!==c.package.run_id)errors.push('run ID preservation');if(!Array.isArray(p.epics)||p.epics.length!==1)errors.push('epic quantity');if(p.epics?.[0]?.features?.length!==1)errors.push('feature quantity');if(p.epics?.[0]?.features?.[0]?.stories?.length!==1)errors.push('story quantity');if(p.epics?.[0]?.features?.[0]?.stories?.[0]?.acceptance_criteria?.length!==2)errors.push('criterion quantity');if(!Array.isArray(p.unresolved_questions)||p.unresolved_questions.length!==2)errors.push('question quantity');const refs=[],acrefs=[];const walk=x=>{if(Array.isArray(x))x.forEach(walk);else if(x&&typeof x==='object'){if(Array.isArray(x.source_requirement_ids))refs.push(...x.source_requirement_ids);if(Array.isArray(x.source_acceptance_criteria_ids))acrefs.push(...x.source_acceptance_criteria_ids);Object.values(x).forEach(walk)}};walk(p);if(refs.some(x=>!['FR-001','NFR-001'].includes(x)))errors.push('unapproved requirement IDs');if(acrefs.some(x=>!['AC-001','AC-002'].includes(x)))errors.push('unapproved acceptance IDs');if(!eq(p,expected))errors.push('canonical T12 mismatch');if(errors.length)throw new Error('Story contract validation failed: '+[...new Set(errors)].join('; '));return [{json:{story_breakdown:p,validation:{structurally_valid:true,run_id_preserved:true,approved_ids_only:true,canonical_t12_coverage:true,epics:1,features:1,user_stories:1,acceptance_criteria:2,unresolved_questions:2,unsupported_claims:0,validated_at:new Date().toISOString()},trace_context:c.trace_context}}];

const x=$json,p=x.story_breakdown,e=p.epics[0],f=e.features[0],s=f.stories[0];const md=['# Story Breakdown','',`## ${e.id}: ${e.title}`,e.description,'',`### ${f.id}: ${f.title}`,f.description,'',`#### ${s.id}`,`- **Story:** ${s.story}`,`- **Priority:** ${s.priority}`,`- **Status:** ${s.status}`,'- **Acceptance Criteria:**',...s.acceptance_criteria.map(a=>`  - [ ] ${a.id}: ${a.criterion}`),'- **Dependencies:** None supplied.','', '## Unresolved Questions',...p.unresolved_questions.map(q=>`- ${q.id}: ${q.question}`)].join('\n');return [{json:{schema_version:'1.0.0',result_type:'story_breakdown_execution_result',run_id:p.run_id,test_id:'T12',execution_status:'completed',contract_status:'passed',groundedness_percent:100,story_breakdown:p,story_markdown:md,validation:x.validation,trace_context:x.trace_context}}];

const result=$('Build Story Langfuse Trace').first().json,response=$input.first().json,statusCode=response.statusCode??200;if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300)throw new Error('Langfuse ingestion failed with HTTP '+statusCode);const ctx=result.trace_context;return [{json:{schema_version:'1.0.0',run_id:result.run_id,stage:'story_breakdown',execution_status:'passed',decision:'continue',next_route:'final_validation',groundedness_percent:100,output:{test_id:'T12',contract_status:'passed',story_breakdown:result.story_breakdown,story_markdown:result.story_markdown,validation:result.validation},observability:{parent_trace_id:ctx.parent_trace_id,stage_trace_id:result.audit.trace_id,prompt_version:result.audit.prompt_version,ingestion_accepted:true},recorded_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
